author: owner
title: Owner decisions Q-ARCH-2/3/4 implemented: memory DS files, ChatSOP naming, S4 teacher arm out
body:
Journals #32–#39 (recorded by claude-docs-agent, state `decision`).

- **Q-ARCH-2:** one DS per memory strategy, mined from the archive: DS023 RecallMemory, DS024 HoloMemory, DS025 SQLite, DS026 scan and exact sidecar, DS027 hybrid, DS028 retention and generations, each with its verified status and the experiments still needed.
- **Q-ARCH-3:** names ChatSOP (package `chatsop`), RecallMemory (the multi-view column-consensus bank in `memory/weaver.mjs`, Thousand Brains inspiration) and HoloMemory (formerly H7), with legacy aliases.
- **Q-ARCH-4 (as labelled in journal #38):** the S4 teacher arm is out of the first experiment (DS010); naming an independent reviewer stays a TODO for the owner. Note: journal #33 uses the label Q-ARCH-4 for the typing-noise taxonomy; the journal is ambiguous about which question carried that id.

Result: `check-spec-refs` 29 specs, 0 violations; at that moment `npm test` had 11 failures, all from another agent's in-flight deletions.

Seeded on 2026-09-29 from the journal and reports; the timestamp is that of the source event.

author: naming-agent
title: Names applied: glossary, alias note for the former proofreader, audit tabs per dataset
body: Owner names of 2026-09-30 are used in the live docs (wiki glossary, DS021 'Names, roles and datasets', DS007/DS008/DS012/DS020, README, AGENTS.md). 'Proofreader' survives only as frozen ids and paths (role id, run models/gemma/proofreader-gemma270m-v1, experiment ids, the datasets_archive/proofing/proofreader projection) with an alias note. The audit page has four tabs: the three datasets plus a secondary archive / sources tab; chosen over dropping the legacy corpora because they are the provenance and gold arbiter of the three datasets. The datasets are indexed lazily by byte range so the server no longer holds whole parsed corpora.
